obj.description: The object represented by this node.

parentId.description: The id of this node's parent, if any.

depth.description:
The amount of indentation to display for this node.  It does not need to equal
the actual depth of the node in the tree - we can set all the depths to 0 if
no indentation is desired at all.

hasChildren.description:
Whether this node has any children (visible or not).  This controls whether an
expand icon is displayed for the node.

children.description: Child nodes in the order that will be displayed.

title: A representation of an item of a {@link UiSdlTreeList}.
name: UiSdlTreeListNode
